title: A reproducible, answer-preserving benchmark for relational identity reasoning: accuracy, answer stability, and response coverage of large language models under controlled evidence conditions

creators.name: Tsai, Ming-Han
creators.affiliation: Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science, Feng Chia University

description: Reproducibility materials for evidence-conditioned relational identity reasoning with seven answer-preserving evidence levels (B0-B6): world generator, fixed seeds, executable question queries, evidence views, uniqueness validators, exact model inputs, recorded responses, scoring tables and offline analysis programs. The data are distributed as a 20-part split archive; see README.md for restoration and verification.
